<!-- =========================================================
     Lumière Med Spa · DEMO WEBSITE by Radiance Tech (Med spa, Scottsdale, AZ)
     Fictional business for portfolio use. Paste this whole file into one GHL Custom HTML element.
     RE-THEME: edit the token block below.
     ========================================================= -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500;1,600&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Great+Vibes&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<div class="dm-lumier light" data-dm="dm-lumier" id="dm-lumier-top">
<style>
.dm-lumier{
  /* ---------- THEME TOKENS (edit only this block to re-theme) ---------- */
  --d-bg:#F8F1EC; --d-bg2:#F1E6DE; --d-surf:#FFFDFB;
  --d-ink:#2B211E; --d-ink-rgb:43,33,30; --d-bg-rgb:248,241,236;
  --d-acc:#A8804D; --d-acc-rgb:168,128,77; --d-on:#FFFFFF;
  --d-muted:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.68); --d-line:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.12); --d-line2:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.22);
  --d-shadow:0 30px 60px -32px rgba(16,24,40,.28);
  --d-disp:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;
  --d-body:"Manrope",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --d-magic:"Great Vibes",var(--d-disp);   /* niche accent font for highlighted words */
  --d-magic-style:normal; --d-magic-w:400; --d-magic-size:1.14em; --d-magic-ls:0;
  --d-r:28px; --d-rbtn:999px; --d-rimg:28px;
  --d-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
}

.dm-lumier,.dm-lumier *,.dm-lumier *::before,.dm-lumier *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
.dm-lumier{position:relative;font-family:var(--d-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--d-ink);background:var(--d-bg);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
.dm-lumier a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.dm-lumier ul,.dm-lumier ol{list-style:none}.dm-lumier img{display:block;max-width:100%}.dm-lumier svg{flex:none;display:block}
.dm-lumier button,.dm-lumier input,.dm-lumier select{font:inherit;color:inherit}.dm-lumier button{background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.dm-lumier :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--d-acc);outline-offset:3px}
.dm-lumier h1,.dm-lumier h2,.dm-lumier h3,.dm-lumier h4{font-family:var(--d-disp);color:var(--d-ink);font-weight:800;line-height:1.05}
.dm-lumier .w{width:100%;max-width:1240px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:20px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .w{padding-inline:40px}}
.dm-lumier em{font-style:normal;color:var(--d-acc)}
/* demo ribbon */
.dm-lumier .demo{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px 14px;padding:9px 16px;background:var(--d-acc);background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-acc) 90%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-acc) 84%,#fff) 82%,transparent));backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--d-on);font-size:13px;text-align:center;line-height:1.35}
.dm-lumier .demo b{font-weight:700}.dm-lumier .demo i{font-style:normal}@media(max-width:559px){.dm-lumier .demo .lg{display:none}.dm-lumier .demo{flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:10px;font-size:12.5px}}.dm-lumier .demo u{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-on) 16%,transparent)}.dm-lumier .demo u svg{width:14px;height:14px}
/* header */
.dm-lumier .tp{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50}
.dm-lumier .hd{position:relative;z-index:50;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.1);transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.dm-lumier.hdk .hd:not(.fx){color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}.dm-lumier.hdk .hd:not(.fx) .lt b{color:#fff}.dm-lumier.hdk .hd:not(.fx) .lt small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.dm-lumier .hd.fx{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.9);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-color:var(--d-line);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);animation:dm-lumier-drop .45s var(--d-ease)}
@keyframes dm-lumier-drop{from{transform:translateY(-100%)}}
.dm-lumier .hero{padding-top:var(--tph,112px)}.dm-lumier .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:calc(var(--tph,112px) + 90px);z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.9),rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.55) 55%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),0))}.dm-lumier section[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}
.dm-lumier .hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;height:72px}
.dm-lumier .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.dm-lumier .lm{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 4px);background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-lumier .lm svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.dm-lumier .lt{display:grid;line-height:1}.dm-lumier .lt b{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.dm-lumier .lt small{margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-lumier .nl{display:none;gap:30px;font-weight:500;font-size:15px}.dm-lumier .nl a{opacity:.85;transition:opacity .2s}.dm-lumier .nl a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-lumier .hr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.dm-lumier .ph{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}.dm-lumier .ph svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .ph span{display:none}
@media(min-width:960px){.dm-lumier .nl{display:flex}.dm-lumier .ph span{display:inline}}
@media(max-width:420px){.dm-lumier .hd .btn--sm{padding:0 14px}}
/* buttons */
.dm-lumier .btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:54px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:var(--d-rbtn);font-weight:700;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:transform .3s var(--d-ease),box-shadow .3s,background .2s,border-color .2s}
.dm-lumier .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;transition:transform .3s var(--d-ease)}.dm-lumier .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.dm-lumier .btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.dm-lumier .btn--acc{background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.85)}
.dm-lumier .btn--ghost{border-color:var(--d-line2);color:var(--d-ink)}.dm-lumier .btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--d-ink)}.dm-lumier .btn--ghost svg{color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .btn--ghost:hover svg{transform:none}
.dm-lumier .btn--on{background:var(--d-on);color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-lumier .btn--sm{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;font-size:14.5px}.dm-lumier .btn--full{width:100%}
.dm-lumier .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-lumier .ctas .btn{width:100%}}
/* type */
.dm-lumier h1{font-weight:inherit;font-size:clamp(40px,5.4vw,74px);letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1}
.dm-lumier h1 .l{display:block}
.dm-lumier .lede{margin-top:22px;max-width:56ch;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,19.5px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-lumier .kick{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-lumier .kick::before{content:"";width:24px;height:2px;background:currentColor}
.dm-lumier .h2{margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,58px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.04;text-wrap:balance}
.dm-lumier .lead{margin-top:16px;max-width:60ch;font-size:17.5px;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-lumier .head{max-width:760px;margin-bottom:48px}.dm-lumier .head.c{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}.dm-lumier .head.c .lead{margin-inline:auto}
.dm-lumier .stars{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;color:#FFB400}.dm-lumier .stars svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.dm-lumier .rate{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 14px 7px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.07);border:1px solid var(--d-line);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:22px}
.dm-lumier .rate b{font-weight:800}.dm-lumier .rate .lp svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-lumier .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;margin-top:26px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
.dm-lumier .chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.dm-lumier .chips svg{width:18px;height:18px;padding:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}
/* cards */
.dm-lumier .card{position:relative;background:var(--d-surf);border:1.5px solid var(--d-line);border-radius:var(--d-r);box-shadow:var(--d-shadow)}
/* hero A: photo + form */
.dm-lumier .hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.dm-lumier .hbg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:#111 center/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.04);animation:dm-lumier-zoom 18s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes dm-lumier-zoom{to{transform:scale(1)}}
.dm-lumier .hsh{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.96) 0%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.86) 42%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.35) 100%)}
.dm-lumier .hA .hgrid{display:grid;gap:36px;align-items:center;padding-block:56px 64px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .hA .hgrid{grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:56px;padding-block:84px 96px;min-height:min(760px,calc(100svh - 110px))}}
.dm-lumier .hA h1,.dm-lumier .hC h1{color:#fff}.dm-lumier .hA .lede,.dm-lumier .hC .lede{color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}.dm-lumier .hA .rate,.dm-lumier .hC .rate{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff}
.dm-lumier .hA .btn--ghost,.dm-lumier .hC .btn--ghost{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}.dm-lumier .hA .chips,.dm-lumier .hC .chips{color:#fff}
.dm-lumier.light .hsh{background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(10,14,22,.9) 0%,rgba(10,14,22,.7) 45%,rgba(10,14,22,.2) 100%)}
/* quote form */
.dm-lumier .qcard{padding:26px 22px}
@media(min-width:560px){.dm-lumier .qcard{padding:30px 28px}}
.dm-lumier .hA .qcard{border-top:4px solid var(--d-acc)}
.dm-lumier .qf{display:grid;gap:12px}
.dm-lumier .qt{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;line-height:1.1}.dm-lumier .qs{margin-top:-6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-lumier .row2{display:grid;gap:12px}@media(min-width:420px){.dm-lumier .row2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.dm-lumier .qf label{display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-lumier .qf input,.dm-lumier .qf select{width:100%;height:52px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.5 + 6px);border:1.5px solid var(--d-line2);background:var(--d-bg);color:var(--d-ink);font-size:16px;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.dm-lumier .qf select{background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,currentColor 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,currentColor 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 23px,calc(100% - 15px) 23px;background-size:5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.dm-lumier .qf input:focus,.dm-lumier .qf select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--d-acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.18)}
.dm-lumier .qf input.bad{border-color:#E5484D}
.dm-lumier .qf .btn{margin-top:4px}
.dm-lumier .fine{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--d-muted)}.dm-lumier .fine svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.dm-lumier .done{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center;padding:20px 0}.dm-lumier .done[hidden]{display:none}
.dm-lumier .ok{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-lumier .ok svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.dm-lumier .done b{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-size:22px}.dm-lumier .done p{color:var(--d-muted);font-size:14.5px}
/* hero B: split + arch photo */
.dm-lumier .hB{background:radial-gradient(60% 70% at 85% 30%,rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14),transparent 70%),var(--d-bg)}
.dm-lumier .hB .hgrid{display:grid;gap:44px;align-items:center;padding-block:48px 72px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .hB .hgrid{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:64px;padding-block:72px 96px;min-height:min(740px,calc(100svh - 110px))}}
.dm-lumier .hart{position:relative}
.dm-lumier .arch{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/4.4;border-radius:min(var(--d-rimg),40px);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(16,24,40,.45)}
.dm-lumier .arch img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.dm-lumier .float{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--d-surf);border:1px solid var(--d-line);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -20px rgba(16,24,40,.35);font-size:14px}
.dm-lumier .float b{display:block;font-size:14.5px}.dm-lumier .float small{display:block;color:var(--d-muted);font-size:12.5px}
.dm-lumier .float .ic{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14);color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .float .ic svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.dm-lumier .f1{left:-14px;bottom:28px}.dm-lumier .f2{right:-10px;top:24px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-lumier .f1{left:10px;bottom:14px}.dm-lumier .f2{right:10px;top:12px}}
/* hero C: centered big */
.dm-lumier .hC{text-align:center}
.dm-lumier .hC .hsh{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.72),rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.82) 55%,var(--d-bg))}
.dm-lumier.light .hC .hsh{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,14,22,.65),rgba(10,14,22,.82))}
.dm-lumier .hc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding-block:88px 56px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .hc{padding-block:120px 72px;min-height:min(640px,calc(100svh - 230px));justify-content:center}}
.dm-lumier .hC h1{max-width:18ch;font-size:clamp(42px,6.2vw,90px)}.dm-lumier .hC .lede{margin-inline:auto}.dm-lumier .hC .ctas,.dm-lumier .hC .chips{justify-content:center}
.dm-lumier .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:24px}
.dm-lumier .pill i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.3)}
.dm-lumier .hstrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;margin-bottom:40px;border-radius:var(--d-r);overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:0}
@media(min-width:900px){.dm-lumier .hstrip{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-bottom:56px}}
.dm-lumier .hstrip>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0 12px;align-items:center;padding:18px 18px;background:rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.82);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);text-align:left;color:#fff}
.dm-lumier .hstrip svg{grid-row:span 2;width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .hstrip b{font-size:15px}.dm-lumier .hstrip span{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.dm-lumier .hC .hstrip{max-width:calc(1240px - 80px);width:calc(100% - 40px)}
/* trust row */
.dm-lumier .trust{background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}
.dm-lumier .tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px 20px;padding-block:18px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px}
@media(min-width:900px){.dm-lumier .tr{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);justify-content:space-between}}
.dm-lumier .tr div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.dm-lumier .tr svg{width:22px;height:22px}
/* sections */
.dm-lumier .sec{padding-block:84px}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .sec{padding-block:120px}}
.dm-lumier .sec.alt{background:var(--d-bg2)}
.dm-lumier .sg{display:grid;gap:16px}@media(min-width:640px){.dm-lumier .sg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .sg{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}}
.dm-lumier .sv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:28px 26px;transition:transform .5s var(--d-ease),border-color .3s}
.dm-lumier .sv:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.6)}
.dm-lumier .ib{display:grid;place-items:center;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 4px);background:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14);color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .ib svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.dm-lumier .sv h3{margin-top:20px;font-size:23px}.dm-lumier .sv p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--d-muted);font-size:15.5px}
.dm-lumier .more{margin-top:auto;padding-top:18px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-lumier .more svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .3s}.dm-lumier .sv:hover .more svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
.dm-lumier .split{display:grid;gap:44px;align-items:center}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-lumier .split{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:72px}}
.dm-lumier .split.top{align-items:start}
.dm-lumier .pic{position:relative}.dm-lumier .pic img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/4.3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--d-rimg)}
.dm-lumier .badge{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 6px);background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.dm-lumier .badge b{display:block;font-family:var(--d-disp);font-size:20px;line-height:1.1}.dm-lumier .badge span{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.dm-lumier .why{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:28px}.dm-lumier .why li{display:flex;gap:14px}
.dm-lumier .ck{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-lumier .ck svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.dm-lumier .why b{font-size:17px}.dm-lumier .why p{color:var(--d-muted);font-size:15.5px}
.dm-lumier .offer{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--d-acc),rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.82));color:var(--d-on)}
.dm-lumier .ob{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px 32px;padding-block:34px}
.dm-lumier .ob .tag{display:inline-block;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.14);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.dm-lumier .ob p{margin-top:10px;font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px);line-height:1.15;max-width:30ch}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-lumier .ob .btn{width:100%}}
.dm-lumier .steps{display:grid;gap:16px}@media(min-width:900px){.dm-lumier .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}}
